releases.read: Copied by Neil from stats.ncaa.org into his Google Sheet '11/9 - MSOC NPI' (Drive 1L1yELedlxhi2QExQ_K4G5PQXmjyhJEBBqFGqEMrirC0, 202 teams) on 2026-11-09 and read from there by Claude; stats.ncaa.org refused Claude's reads (Access Denied). The sheet has no headings, so the columns are taken in the page's order (Prev NPI 159 matches). Google Sheets had turned two W-L-T cells into dates: DII WL '4-9-2003' is 4-9-3 (the record on the 11/1 release) and vAbove '2-9-2002' is 2-9-2; restored here. vBelow was blank in the copy (2-0-1 on 11/1). Team names carry the page's new '(AQ)' marks. Through date = the day before the release. source_url is the current-rankings page; the copy does not carry the release's fixed id. Region rank = Biola's position among the region's teams sorted by NPI rank.
releases.official_basis: Release date on the official 2026-27 schedule (npi/schedule.json), linked from NCAA.com's NPI Rankings page

releases.read: Copied by Neil from stats.ncaa.org into his Google Sheet 'WSOC NPI 11/9/26' (Drive 1_jy5wKR43wcwbTJKHHhsi0S1xZhgL9UBJzkrH517rPA, 259 teams) and read from there by Claude on 2026-11-10; stats.ncaa.org refused Claude's reads (Access Denied).
